Moderna  gained 13% to $156.92 and was the best-performing stock in the  Wolfe Research upgraded the stock to Peer Perform from Underperform without a price target.  Shares surged nearly 180% to $174.38 on Aug. 19, after a late-stage trial showed a treatment combining Moderna and Merck’s experimental vaccine, intismeran autogene, and  Merck  Keytruda was more effective at preventing skin cancer recurrence than Keytruda alone.
